title: Work Journal suggestions: show the project in its colour, and keep Accept and Reject apart, green and red
story: Work Journal suggestion cards now name the project the work came from, in that project's colour, next to the source tag; before, only the source tag showed. Accept and Reject used to be grey and 8px apart; now Accept is green and Reject is red, 24px apart. Meeting suggestions still show no project.

checks.criterion: A suggestion from project work shows that project's name in its colour; one with no project (or an older one) shows no pill and no error.
checks.steps: Open a made-up project folder such as 'demo-shop' in Maestro. Make a commit in it. Open the Work Journal and click 'run now'. If Granola is connected, have a test meeting that day.
checks.expected: The project suggestion shows a small 'demo-shop' pill in the same colour as that project's terminal border. A meeting suggestion, or one stored before this change, shows no pill and no error.

checks.criterion: Accept is green, Reject is red, with at least a button's width between them.
checks.steps: With any pending suggestion, look at its row. Click the red cross on one suggestion. Create the day's page, then click the green tick on another.
checks.expected: The tick and the cross are clearly apart. The cross hides its suggestion. The tick adds the line to the page.
